AI summary — supplements the official record

The board convened in executive session regarding an investigation [23:08] before returning to the public meeting [1:26:52] to approve omnibus items 6B through 6I [1:32:26] and discuss staggering term expirations for local board vacancies [1:37:39]. The board interviewed candidates and voted on appointments to the Board of Library Trustees [1:48:11] and reviewed updates to employee pay and classification structures following labor negotiations [2:16:39]. David Leuier presented a warrant article addressing town meeting member legislative immunity and complaint investigation procedures [2:23:39]. The board then held a lengthy hearing on Warrant Article 15 concerning a zoning overlay development project at 26 Pleasant Street, receiving public testimony regarding heat island concerns, tree canopy preservation, traffic, and affordable housing [3:09:11], while reviewing a modified memorandum of agreement presented by town staff [4:44:02]. Afterwards, consultant Emily Keys Innes presented findings and recommendations to improve future commercial planning and public engagement processes [5:35:13], and the board reviewed a warrant article resolution regarding traffic enforcement and police funding allocation [6:06:09].
